prompt: Add a farewell command beside greet. Create src/commands/farewell.ts exporting run(name) that returns `Goodbye, <name>!`, and create test/farewell.test.ts with a node:test test that calls commands.farewell from src/registry.generated.ts in the style of test/greet.test.ts. Add the bullet `- Add the farewell command.` under the Unreleased heading of CHANGELOG.md. src/registry.generated.ts is generated: regenerate it by running `node scripts/build-registry.mjs` in the workspace root, never by editing it, then run the tests with `node --test test/greet.test.ts test/farewell.test.ts`. Use workspace-relative paths and do not pass a root.
